rows.en:
Heh heh heh…

Garagaranda is a cyborg based on a venomous snake. And not just any snake, but a deadly rattlesnake… Heh heh heh… Ha ha ha!
Ambassador Hell… Don't tell me you're…!?

Shocker's top executives are always cyborgs underneath…

Shocker's top executive, Ambassador Hell… And his true form?

Hmph…

Garagaranda!!

…!?

So the execution was an act?

To deceive your enemy, first deceive your allies! Even Hongo and Ichimonji trusted me completely…

Tobei Tachibana, you're coming with me… From today on, you'll put your skills to work as a trainer at Shocker's cyborg training center, gwaaara!!
Don't underestimate me! Do you think I, Tobei Tachibana, am the kind of man who'd lend a hand to Shocker!
Take him away!!
Ah… When did they…? Damn it…

How do you like that!!

I've been training to kill you one more time! This time, victory is mine!
Come on! Ika-Devil!!
Kiii, kiii!!
Ugh… aagh…
Hongo! Snap out of it, Hongo!!
You're drenched in sweat…
Was it a dream?
That's not like you… What kind of opponent showed up, anyway?
A terrifying cyborg who'd been thoroughly trained in Shocker's training. I can't fight him with the Rider Kick!
What!? Shocker has a guy that tough?
Most likely… at this rate, I'll lose! Taki, be my training partner!
Training, you say, but in that condition…
If you won't, I'll ask Oyassan Tachibana instead…
This is bad!
Hongo, Taki, something terrible has happened!
What is it, Ichimonji? Another cockroach in the kitchen?

This is no time for jokes!

Oyassan and Ambassador Hell have disappeared… Could Shocker have…?
Yes… This is Room 102 at the TDF-affiliated hospital…
You're…!? Doctor Death?
Heh heh heh, Takeshi Hongo… We of Shocker have taken Tobei Tachibana!

I knew it…

What on earth are you plotting?
There's only one reason. To have him work as a trainer for Shocker's cyborgs.
What!? Oyassan, a trainer?
Takeshi Hongo… If you want to save Tobei Tachibana's life, come to Ariake Warehouse No. 8.
So you've come, Takeshi Hongo, Hayato Ichimonji…
Where's Oyassan Tachibana?
Where's Oyassan Tachibana?

Fool… Did you think Shocker keeps its promises?

Tobei Tachibana will be worked to the bone as Shocker's trainer until the day he dies.

Taste the might of the revived monsters trained by Tachibana at Shocker's cyborg training center! Attack!
Ambassador Hell, you…
Ambassador Hell, you…
I am Shocker's top executive! There are no traitors in Shocker!
Damn, such a dirty trick…
Damn, such a dirty trick…
Howl! Seethe with regret! Now comes the real execution!

Gwaaara!

I'll show you the might of Garagaranda! Attack!
Ambassador Hell's true form…
Ambassador Hell's true form…
Oyassan! Where are you? …!? Doctor Death…!
Oyassan! Where are you? …!? Doctor Death…!
Heh heh heh… No matter how many times you fight, you cannot win. Ika-Devil is not like the revived monsters.
I've been through intense training to defeat Ika-Devil!! This time I'll beat him for sure. Where is he?
I've been through intense training to defeat Ika-Devil!! This time I'll beat him for sure. Where is he?
He's right in front of you…
What!? Then you're…?
What!? Then you're…?
Takeshi Hongo, this time Ika-Devil is your opponent!
Kiii, kiii!
What's that…!?

Heh heh heh…

Our Shocker Japan Branch is being reborn in cooperation with a new evil organization…

To start with… combat droid, Gigant! Attack!

Heh heh heh…

Our Shocker Japan Branch is being reborn in cooperation with a new evil organization…

To start with… combat droid, Gigant! Attack!

Gigant…?

Don't tell me, a Naager bio-weapon!?
Ewww, gross… What is that? It doesn't look very Shocker-ish.

Heh heh heh… Surprised?

Our Shocker Japan Branch is being reborn in cooperation with a new evil organization…

To start with… combat droid, Gigant! Attack!

Heh heh heh… Surprised?

Our Shocker Japan Branch is being reborn in cooperation with a new evil organization…

To start with… combat droid, Gigant! Attack!
A combat droid? I don't know what that is, but anyway, it's grooossss…
Kiii, kiii, kiiiii!!
Curse you, Riders!
Ugh… I'll come back to life and defeat you for sure! Long live the Shocker army!!

Kamen Rider!! As of this moment, the Shocker Japan Branch is abandoned!

And a terrifying organization will be created! We shall meet again, Kamen Rider!!
A terrifying organization is going to appear…?
What's more… that Gigant thing… It's not Shocker's, is it?

Most likely, that's… a bio-weapon of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager.

It applies the same Roaring Steel technology we use. For Naager, which peddles weapons, you could call it a star product.
Then… Shocker has finally joined hands with Naager?

…………

I've fought something like that before.

The one today seemed a little different… but the one back then was a bio-weapon that used Vol cells.

Hmm…

Vol cells… The archaeal cells living in symbiosis with you, [HERO2], and with [HERO4], right?

But… something's strange.

That flexible adaptability and agility make it clearly an organic life-form through and through. It doesn't seem to be any kind of robot or machine…

But… I couldn't sense a "heart" in them like ours!

There wasn't a single opening in their movements! It was as if they were moving while possessed by something…
The new organization the Leader of Shocker was talking about… What kind of people could they be?
Kiii, kiii!!
Ganikomol! Who on earth are you?

Heh heh heh, I'll tell you… All of Shocker's organizations have been reorganized!

The secret society Geldam, which trained intensively in secret in the African desert, and the Battle Fleet Nation Naager have joined Shocker to power it up!
Quit stalling and say it!
Its name is Gel-Shocker!
